translations.web: Make a joyful noise to Yahweh, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!
translations.bsb: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth; break forth—let your cry ring out, and sing praises!
translations.kjv: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing
translations.asv: Make a joyful noise unto Jehovah, all the earth: Break forth and sing for joy, yea, sing praises.
